{{Quote|This will be a good opportunity for you to reflect on connection with the Living Force. There are beings from all over the galaxy here. You'll pick up many kinds of energies. With such a variety of beings crowded onto one planet, there is much to learn.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Games''' was a championship that was held across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that occurred on a different host [[Planet/Legends|planet]] every seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]], with individuals competing in a variety of races and contests, all of them exciting and dangerous, but against which betting was illegal.

The [[Games Council]] organized the events. In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], they did this with help from the [[Ruling Power]], the governing body of that year's host planet, [[Euceron]].

==History==
The first Galactic Games were held around [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]], in an expansive effort to promote peace through sports. When the Games were held on [[Berrun]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the undisputed star was the Euceronian athlete [[Maxo Vista]], who stunned the galaxy when he won five separate events. To honor Vista's homeworld, the Galactic Games were next held on Euceron in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].

Three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] teams were sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], at Euceron's request and with the approval of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], to keep the peace during those events—including [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who arrived at the planet's capital city, [[Eusebus]], in a [[Galan starfighter]]. While there, the Jedi foiled a plot involving high-profile Games Council members to increase their planet's prestige among the Galactic Senate by "fixing" or rigging not only some of the official games, but also an illegal podrace at the [[Great Dordon Caves]] on the city's northern border.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>

During the Games, a representative from each planet played on teams competing in 20 different sponsored events. These included [[Team Coruscant]], [[Team Fondor]], [[Team Fwillsving]], [[Team Kinyen]], [[Team Kothlis]], [[Team Kubindi]], [[Team Ord Mantell]], [[Team Ralltiir]], [[Team Tralus]], and [[Team Yag'Dhul]].

In addition, in a crowd-filled Stadium Nine, former Games champion (and corrupt Games Council member) Maxo Vista forced [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Obi-Wan Kenobi to compete with him in "the exhibition match"—an intense, fast-moving [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] obstacle course that the former Galactic champion had rigged with a real [[Gladiator droid/Legends|Gladiator droid]] among a platoon of holographic droid renditions. Kenobi, however, still won the competition, shaming the former champion.

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the games were called the [[Imperial Games]]. An assassination attempt on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] occurred when the Games were held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
